title: ... every filthy word in your vocabulary then I highly recommend buying these end tables
text:
... every filthy word in your vocabulary then I highly recommend buying these end tables. If you want your child(ren) to learn every filthy word in your vocabulary then I highly recommend buying these end tables. With the amount of pulling and pushing and forcing things to fit your child will be fluent in profanities in no time.

Assembly was a pain. Literally. The tables are so uneven it’s unreal. As you can see in the phot we had to place pieces of cardboard under one side to keep the tables level. Not one but both were unsteady so I highly doubt defective product to be the issue.

These scratch ridiculously easy. Barely scathing the side with the Allen wrench left gouge marks similar to saber tooth tiger claws.

These look awesome in the picture. In real life they look decent but perform terribly.
